# Andrés Morales — AI Consultant for Business Automation

> AI consultant helping companies automate their operations with AI. Designs and ships n8n workflows, AI agents, and internal tools that replace manual work — so teams can focus on growth, not busywork.
>
> Site: [andresmorales.com.co](https://andresmorales.com.co)
> Email: [info@andresmorales.com.co](mailto:info@andresmorales.com.co)

## About Andrés

Andrés Morales is an AI automation consultant and full-stack builder with more than a decade of experience in sales, UX design, and engineering. He works hands-on: every engagement ships production-ready automation, not deliverables or mockups.

- **Based in:** Bogotá, Colombia (GMT-5)
- **Languages:** Spanish (native, es-CO), English (fluent, en-US), Portuguese (fluent, pt-BR)
- **LinkedIn:** [linkedin.com/in/andresmoralesc1](https://www.linkedin.com/in/andresmoralesc1/)
- **GitHub:** [github.com/andresmoralesc1](https://github.com/andresmoralesc1/)
- **Email:** [info@andresmorales.com.co](mailto:info@andresmorales.com.co)
- **Site:** [andresmorales.com.co](https://andresmorales.com.co)

## What he does

### AI Automation

End-to-end workflow automation using n8n, Make, and custom code. Replaces the manual, repetitive work that eats team capacity.

- Lead nurturing and CRM updates (HubSpot, Pipedrive)
- Cold outreach and follow-up sequences
- Internal reporting and data syncing (Airtable, Sheets, Postgres)
- Webhook-driven integrations between SaaS tools
- Vendor-independent architecture (no lock-in)

### AI Agents

Intelligent experiences that guide users and complete real work, not toy chatbots.

- Customer support triage and routing
- Lead qualification and intake
- Document Q&A and internal search
- Sales assistants trained on the company's own data
- Workflows with versioned prompts and human-in-the-loop

### UI/UX Design

Product design for SaaS dashboards, e-commerce storefronts, and internal tools. Brand systems, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes in Figma.

- Wireframes → prototypes → handoff
- Design systems and component libraries
- Conversion-focused landing pages
- UX audits with prioritized recommendations

### Web Development

Full-stack web applications built on Next.js, React, and TypeScript. PostgreSQL backends, containerized deployment, and Cloudflare in front.

- Marketing sites with i18n (Spanish, English, Portuguese)
- Internal tools and dashboards
- Custom integrations with Stripe, HubSpot, and other APIs
- VPS deployment with Docker + Caddy

## Selected projects

- [Superllantas](https://superllantas.co/) — e-commerce redesign and automation for a Colombian tire retailer
- [Kambelleh](https://kambelleh.com/) — full PMS (Property Management System) for a boutique hotel in Salento
- [BarrioTech — GPS Street Sellers](https://gps.andresmorales.com.co/) — civic tech app for mapping street vendors in Bogotá
- [HubIAgency](https://hubiagency.com/) — lead generation and client onboarding automation for a marketing agency
- [Tory Skateshop](https://toryskateshop.com/) — e-commerce and operations system for a specialty retailer
- [SoapArtesana](https://soapartesana.com/) — direct-to-consumer storefront and order-fulfillment pipeline
- [Carmen Job Search](https://carmenjobsearch.com/) — internal ATS for a recruiting firm
- [Talobot](https://talobot.co/) — Telegram bot for sales-team task automation
- [Juan Becerra](https://juanbecerram.com/) — branding and website for a B2B sales consultant

## Tools & stack

- **Automation:** n8n, Make, Zapier, custom Node.js
- **AI:** OpenAI, Anthropic, vector databases, RAG
- **Frontend:** Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Backend:** Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker
- **Integrations:** HubSpot, Pipedrive, Airtable, Stripe, WhatsApp Business API
- **Design:** Figma
- **Infrastructure:** VPS, Cloudflare, Caddy, systemd, PM2
- **Languages:** Spanish (native), English (fluent), Portuguese (fluent)

## How to engage

Three ways to work together:

1. **Start a project** — fill the brief wizard at [andresmorales.com.co/brief](https://andresmorales.com.co/brief)
2. **Strategy call** — book a free 30-minute call via the [contact page](https://andresmorales.com.co/contact)
3. **Quick question** — send a short note via [andresmorales.com.co/contact](https://andresmorales.com.co/contact)

Response time: brief inquiries are read personally within 24 hours. Reasonable rates disclosed after a discovery call, never before.
